title: Wrong-shape vector cache recovery path
failure_mode: Cache rebuild path versus model fallback

context.question: Statically review the selected evidence. Separate supported observations from unverified outcomes and propose focused checks.

findings.statement: A wrong-shape vector result clears the stored vector state, attempts to unlink the index path, and, if unlink does not raise OSError, asks the superclass for vectors again.
findings.rationale: The selected conditional shows all three actions.

findings.statement: This recovery path switches to a local prebuilt model when the hosted cache has the wrong shape.
findings.rationale: The comment specifies the same hosted provider and the code calls the superclass again without selecting a local provider.

next_steps.proposal: Propose fake superclass results with a wrong shape on both attempts to check the final EmbeddingUnavailable branch.
next_steps.rationale: It exercises the selected retry-of-shape-recovery path as a test, without claiming a provider success.
